evidence.detail: No GitHub PR achievement class exists in the current codebase; the 12+ achievement classes do not reference GitHub or pull requests

silasary's comment: 'requires linking GitHub to person, or manually assigning achievement'; adambiltcliffe: 'not much gain in associating player with GitHub login just to avoid manually adding a single achievement'

triage.notes: Feature requires deciding: (a) whether to build GitHub-account-to-PD-person linking, or (b) manually grant achievement by hand. Discussion in issue shows disagreement on whether GitHub linking is worth it for this use case alone.
